meta.task: Send a weekly newsletter from my RSS reads
meta.title: Weekly RSS Newsletter

nodes.label: Collect feed list
nodes.description: Gather the RSS feed URLs and the sending schedule from the user.

nodes.label: Fetch new articles
nodes.description: Manually fetch each feed, parse XML, filter to the last 7 days.

nodes.label: Summarize articles
nodes.description: Read each article and write a 2-sentence summary.

nodes.label: Select top stories
nodes.description: Rank summaries and pick the 5 best for this issue.

nodes.label: Draft the email
nodes.description: Compose subject line and HTML body from the selected summaries.

nodes.label: Human review
nodes.description: User proofreads the draft and requests edits.

nodes.label: Send the issue
nodes.description: Paste the final HTML into the newsletter service and hit send.

suggestions.name: example/rss-mcp
suggestions.claim: Fetches and filters feeds in one tool call instead of manual parsing.
suggestions.install: claude mcp add rss -- npx rss-mcp

replaceWith.label: Fetch + digest via MCP
replaceWith.description: One MCP call returns filtered, summarized articles.
